name: BLIFFERT RES (KYLE)
address: 1814 NW WILD RYE CIRCLE, BEND, OR 97703

fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Detached Structure Complexity; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance that is visible from both directions of travel on the street.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responders arriving from either direction can identify the access point without delay.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive so emergency vehicles can travel its full length without obstruction.
• Clear vegetation back from both sides of the access drive to allow vehicle doors to open and responders to move alongside vehicles.
• Identify and mark a turnaround location on the property so responders do not have to back blindly to the street.
• Keep the area nearest the main residence clear of parked vehicles so arriving units have a direct staging position at the structure.
• Post the detached structure's location visibly from the driveway entrance, or mark a clear path to it, so responders can locate it without searching.
• Trim vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between them on foot without obstruction.
• Keep all perimeter gates unlocked or secured with a combination that is shared with the local fire and emergency services.
• Confirm that gate hardware allows the gate to be opened quickly from both sides without tools or keys.
• Remove or relocate any vehicles or equipment stored along the access drive that would prevent a fire apparatus from reaching the rear of the property.

wildfire.conditions: Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Scattered Shrubs; Vegetation Near Structure; Mixed Vegetation; Long Driveway; Single Access Route; Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Ground Vegetation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that extend directly over or touch the roof and walls of the structure.
• Thin the tree clusters closest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants growing directly against the foundation and walls.
• Clear ground vegetation within the immediate area surrounding the structure.
• Separate shrubs from the base of trees so fire cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure so their canopies do not touch or overlap.
• Cut back overhanging branches along the full length of the driveway to keep it passable for vehicles.
• Clear ground vegetation and low branches along both sides of the driveway to maintain a clear travel path.
• Remove dead or dry plant material from the mixed vegetation areas closest to the structure.
• Keep the area immediately around any outbuildings or sheds as clear of plants and shrubs as the main structure.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to locate quickly from the road.
• Maintain the driveway surface so it can support the weight and width of emergency vehicles.
